svg.aria-label: How FollowSpot follows you. Every quarter second, if your mic isn't quiet, the page sends the last 3.5 seconds of audio, plus the last 30 words of the script as a hint, to a whisper.cpp server on 127.0.0.1, so the audio stays on your machine. The newest 14 words it hears are matched against the script from 12 words behind your place to 60 ahead, the highlight moves to the last matched word, and the page scrolls your line to lens height. Backing up for a retake needs at least 4 matched words, and if you keep talking with no match for 1.5 seconds the highlight drifts ahead slowly until it finds you again.
